findings.message: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
The placeholder "ex.: João da Silva Gomes" has a contrast of 3.66:1 with the field (#f0f0f0 on #f9f9f9…#ffffff). Placeholder text is text, and WCAG 1.4.3 asks for 4.5:1.
